requirements.rule: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

requirements.rule: SICKNESS (Art. 66): the employer pays the whole treatment of the elements 1-10 of Art. 44 (INPS pays no indemnity to the impiegati and quadri of industry) for six months, the comporto of a worker with up to two years of service. Not modelled: from two to six years the comporto of nine months with the last three at 50%, over six years twelve months with three months at 75% and three at 50%; for several illnesses or relapses the comporto of 9, 12 or 15 months in 30, whose three extra months are paid in full for the first and at 50% after. The engine stops at day 180 (days past it are marked beyond the comporto).
requirements.remediation: Model the seniority bands of Art. 66 with equal full-pay days and the cumulated comporto in 30 months.

requirements.rule: Art. 65: the premio di fedeltà of one month a year after 20 years of service.
requirements.remediation: Model the premio di fedeltà on seniority.

requirements.rule: Art. 43: the 1/25 for the festività of 4 November.
Art. 54: the premiums on ordinary hours (lavoro festivo 45%, notturno 34% or 10% in shifts, festivo notturno 50%).
requirements.remediation: Model the Art. 54 premiums on ordinary hours.

requirements.rule: APPRENTICESHIP: Art. 92 (ANCE text of 4 April 2019): 72/72/78/78/85/90% by semester for 36 months towards levels 2-7; the apprendistato duale and the alta formazione are not modelled.
requirements.remediation: Model the pay of the apprendistato duale and alta formazione, or refuse them by track.

requirements.rule: Art. 46: the EVR set by the provincial agreements.
requirements.remediation: Add the provincial EVR as an input.

requirements.rule: Mensa, trasporto and trasferta, set by the provincial agreements (verbale 2025).
requirements.remediation: Add the provincial mensa, trasporto and trasferta as inputs.

requirements.rule: PREMIO DI PRODUZIONE: the premio di produzione set by the provincial agreements (Art. 44 n. 5) is owed to every impiegato; the engine reads no provincial agreement. Not modelled: the net pay and the employer cost are short of it.
requirements.remediation: Model the provincial premio di produzione with a fact naming the province, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: The run reads an INPS ruleset marked provisional: the INPS circulars of its year are not published yet, so the rates, the massimale and the minimale (and the hourly contributions of domestic work) are those of the year before, carried over. The indexed amounts change every January: the carried-over values understate them.
requirements.remediation: Replace each provisional INPS ruleset of the year with the values of the INPS circulars of the year, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: The run reads a tax ruleset marked provisional: the sources of its year are not published yet (budget law of the year; regional and municipal surtax resolutions), so the values are those of the year before, carried over. Rules in force by statute (the IRPEF brackets of art. 11 and the deductions of art. 13 of the testo unico of D.Lgs. 117/2026) carry over unchanged; any change of the budget law is not applied.
requirements.remediation: Replace each provisional ruleset of the year with the values of its published sources, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: Art. 76: the absorption of a superminimo into the quadri function allowance. The una tantum premio di ingresso of the verbale of 3 March 2022 and the riduzione contributiva edile concern the operai only.

The CCNL tier and the comporto are counted on the days of one episode and the relapses it continues. A CCNL that sums the sickness of separate episodes over a window (a calendar year, the last three years) can reach a lower tier or the end of the comporto earlier than the engine shows. The run is affected when an earlier episode outside the relapse chain is recorded.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.day.rules (CCNL tier of a sick day)
requirements.remediation: Add the cumulation window of each CCNL to its sickness rule, with the source, and count the tier and the comporto over it.

requirements.rule: The INPS share of a sick day is the INPS rate times the CCNL daily quota of the current month, counted on the CCNL payable days, when the episode does not let the engine compute the INPS daily base: no SicknessEpisode.inps_base in its relapse chain, an operaio without the days worked or paid of the month before, an impiegato of a month not worked in full without the pay of a whole month, an unknown worker category, or a lavoratore dello spettacolo without the pay of the last daily contributions (SpettacoloSicknessBase). With the base, INPS pays its share on the retribuzione media globale giornaliera of the month before the illness and on calendar days (INPS circ. 134368/1981 point 11). The worker's total for the day is the same; the split between INPS indemnity (outside the contribution base) and employer integration may differ, and with it the contributions.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.pay.handlers (INPS share of a sick day); ccnl_engine.sickness.base.rules (daily base)
requirements.remediation: Derive the base from the closing state of the engine's own runs so the caller need not state it, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: Art. 47, 50 and 52: the indennità speciale, di cassa and for alta montagna, cassoni and galleria.
requirements.remediation: Model the allowances of Artt. 47, 50 and 52.

requirements.rule: An apprentice whose TFR goes to a pension fund or to the Fondo Tesoreria takes the 0.28-point relief of D.L. 203/2005 art. 8, but not the exemption from the 0.20% Fondo di garanzia contribution of D.Lgs. 252/2005 art. 10 c. 2: no source found says whether the apprentice rate (10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus NASpI and the integration funds) holds a Fondo di garanzia share to exempt. The employer contributions of the run may be overstated by 0.20% of the INPS base.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.severance.relief.services; INPS messaggio n. 5859 of 7 March 2008, par. 3 (art. 8 relief of apprentices); INPS circ. 70/2007 par. 6 (Fondo di garanzia exemption, rates 0.20% and 0.40%)
requirements.remediation: Find an INPS source on the Fondo di garanzia share of the apprentice rate, then exempt it with the other workers or record that none is due.
